TITLE: AI provider token-efficiency ("min-max tokens") â€” caching, budgeting, routing, local test fallback.

CURRENT STATE (this is an OVERHAUL, not greenfield): provider abstraction already exists at services/agent/providers/ (anthropic/openai/gemini/openrouter/vllm/mock/logging) + a context-compaction path (test_compaction.py) + logging_provider wrapper. Extend these.

SCOPE:
1) Prompt caching (cache_control) on stable prefixes (system/role prompts, tool defs, big context packs) so multi-turn loops reuse cached tokens; report cache-hit rate.
2) Context-window budgeting: turn the existing compaction path into a budget-ceiling manager (drop/summarise stale tool outputs, dedupe injected context, cap snippets), configurable per model.
3) Model routing by stakes: cheap/local (Haiku/vllm) for mechanical steps, Opus/Sonnet for reasoning; policy + per-call override.
4) Local-model TEST fallback: AI_CAD_PROVIDER=local wires the existing vllm_provider to T-W26's bundled model so dev/test/CI spends $0 on paid APIs. Config/env only.
5) Telemetry: per-run tokens/cache/model/$-est via logging_provider; surface into Copilot context bar, share source of truth with T-BL38.

GUARDRAILS: NOT circumventing billing/ToS â€” production keeps the configured PAID provider; local is opt-in test config only. Respect Pillar-12 provider gate.

DoD: caching+hit-rate measured; budget ceiling holds with no eval-bench regression; routing policy live; AI_CAD_PROVIDER=local runs full loop at $0; per-run telemetry integrated w/ T-BL38; MCP freshness (services/mcp instr + context pack + graphify update).

TIES: T-W26, T-WIN2, T-BL38, T-BL22. Full spec saved locally; can paste on request. Hand to services/agent lead to claim.
